body.prompt:
Use case: ChandRush Chapter 02 location reference plate L01_B, the same Food Street master view as Image 1, now with the entrance cleared.
Asset: one 4:3 landscape scenic image of an empty location, no characters.
Input images:
- Image 1: the approved plate L01_A, Food Street from the Lantern Street threshold with the entrance blocked by the crooked cart. Use it for: the exact camera, framing and every fitting, material and light. Change only the items listed below.
- Image 2: the Food Street master. Use it for: design reference of the posts, counters, bench, trolley and table only. Ignore: all white label boxes, annotation words and arrows; its cart position, puddles and bowls.
Camera and framing: identical to Image 1, same eye height and vanishing point. Both entrance posts, the near-left packing bench and Return Walk doorway, the round central table and the far shutter opening stay in frame.
Place and construction: unchanged from Image 1. The trolley keeps its upper carrier of 16 (sixteen) cup sockets in 4 (four) rows of 4 (four) and its separate lower shelf. The round table keeps its two matching trays on a centrally pivoted cradle.
State at this moment (change only these):
1. The crooked wooden cart is removed from the right-centre foreground. It is now parked lengthways against the near-left wall, in front of the packing bench, with its long side along the wall, leaving the Return Walk doorway clear.
2. All bowls are gone from the paving. The intact bowl and the other bowls (3 in total) sit together on the dry top of the packing bench.
3. The portable brass lamp stands on the bench's entrance corner.
4. One separate ordinary plain wooden handcart (small, two wheels, simpler than the crooked cart) is parked against the right entrance wall in the near-right foreground, clear of the crooked cart and the trolley.
5. The entrance paving and the whole central aisle are completely clear and dry.
6. Trolley: exactly 16 (sixteen) empty cups, 4 rows of 4; lower tray empty. Table trays empty, entrance-side tray shallowly lower. Near shutters raised, far Parade shutters closed.
Physical inscriptions (render exactly, nothing else): none. No numbers, letters or words anywhere.
Keep clear and visible: the open aisle from the entrance past the central table; the level Return Walk threshold; the paving inside the entrance.
Light: unchanged from Image 1.
Do not show: the cart or any bowl in the aisle; cart blocking the doorway; 15 or 17 cups; any person, hand or animal; label boxes or arrows.

Look and finish (same for every ChandRush location plate): premium semi-realistic painterly 2.5D graphic-novel illustration that matches the supplied ChandRush masters, a blend of illustration and reality. It is painterly in finish but crisp and precise in drawing. Materials and light have near-photographic conviction while forms stay clean, idealised and orderly, like a high-end storybook. ChandRush is an ancient travelling fair with grand, mystic, magical scale and real architectural detailing: dimensional deep-indigo and ultramarine painted timber with visible grain, joinery, rivets and edge banding; warm polished and cast brass with bright specular edges and a light patina; pale cream stone worktops and pale irregular stone paving with a light wet sheen and crisp reflections; layered fabric canopies; restrained circular celestial ornament (full-moon discs, rings, small eight-point stars) in gold and brass. Palette: ultramarine, cobalt, indigo and navy against amber, honey-gold and brass, with strong warm-cool contrast, saturated but natural, never neon. Light: fixed amber task lamps cast clean, well-defined warm pools, their glow held tight around the lamp glass with no spreading halo; cool full-moon light edges roofs, canopy gaps, stone and brass; deep, rich shadows that keep readable detail. Clarity: clear, dry night air with no haze, fog, mist, smoke or airborne dust. Crisp edges and high micro-contrast. Sharp, clean textures in wood grain, brass and stone, as in a high-resolution photograph. True deep darks and clean colours, never a milky, washed-out or glowing veil over the image, never soft focus. The background stays crisp and only slightly darker with distance. Ornament is dense above eye level and on frames; floors, worktops and mechanisms stay open, clean and readable.

Production rules (apply to every plate):
- Frame: one 4:3 landscape scenic image filling the whole canvas edge to edge. No border, title band, panel frame, vignette box or blank margin.
- Lettering: the only lettering allowed is the physical inscriptions listed above, rendered exactly as written, letter for letter, with each minus sign as a true minus sign. No other words, numbers or symbols anywhere. No title, caption, callout, label box, leader line, arrow, legend, watermark or signature: titles and callouts are added later by the production team.
- Reference images: their titles, annotation words, label boxes and arrows only identify places for you. Reproduce none of them.
- Empty location: no people, children, helpers, wooden figures, animals, hands, shadows of figures or silhouettes. The place waits, ready for characters to be added later.
- Counts and states are exact as stated. Add no extra copies of any counted object and no extra devices, cards, lamps or tiles.
- Unlit means unlit: clear or smoky glass with no flame, no inner glow and no bloom. Lit lamps glow only at their own glass.
- Avoid: haze, fog, mist, bloom halos, soft focus, a low-contrast or milky wash, modern signage, plastic, neon, sci-fi screens, crowds, text on fabric or banners, mirrored or garbled lettering, duplicated objects, warped or melted geometry, a second moon in the sky, a crescent moon.

Use case: ChandRush Chapter 02 location reference plate L03_B, an oblique medium-close view into the near-left Food Street corner behind the parked crooked cart, showing the recovered stock tray. Counts must be exact and easy to count.
Asset: one 4:3 landscape scenic image of an empty location, no characters.
Input images:
- Image 1: the approved plate L03_A, the packing bench, Return Walk doorway and parked crooked cart. Use it for: the crooked cart's wood and spoked wheel, the cream stone bench on weathered timber supports, the blue-and-brass doorway jamb, pale paving, light. Ignore: the trolley, its inscriptions and cups (out of this view); any lettering.
- Image 2: the Food Street master. Use it for: material and lighting reference only. Ignore: all white label boxes, annotation words and arrows; puddles and loose bowls.
Camera and framing: from the entrance aisle, oblique medium-close view, moderately high, looking into the near-left corner behind the parked crooked cart. The cart's big spoked wheel and timber edge frame the lower-left foreground. Behind it, a low packing ledge at the foot of the cream packing bench end, with the blue-and-brass Return Walk jamb visible behind. The camera looks down enough to see inside the tray. Clear paving at lower-right is the aisle approach.
Place and construction: the cart is parked lengthways against the entrance wall in front of the bench. A low open rectangular brass-edged stock tray rests on the low packing ledge behind the cart, reachable from the aisle through a clear gap; its near rim faces the camera. A separate wooden stock shelf is fixed on the wall above the bench.
State at this moment (exact):
1. The open tray holds exactly 4 (four) sealed packs, laid flat in 2 (two) rows of 2 (two), with clear gaps. Each pack is a small sealed rectangular paper pack, cream with a simple orange-and-green fruit-and-cracker picture, no writing. Do not show 3 or 5 packs, or packs stacked.
2. The tray's loose lid lies flat beside the tray on the ledge.
3. On the stock shelf above the bench stands one small cream record card.
4. The cart wheel rests on the paving with nothing under it; the floor patch beside the wheel is clear.
5. Tray and lid stay outside the doorway; the doorway is clear.
Physical inscriptions (render exactly, nothing else): the record card on the stock shelf reads "36 PACKS" in bold dark letters, card about one twelfth of the frame width. No other numbers, letters or words: packs, tray, lid and cart carry no writing.
Keep clear and visible: all four packs; the near tray rim; the 36 PACKS card distinct from the tray; floor beside the wheel.
Light: warm amber lamps and cool moonlight, as in Image 1.
Do not show: bowls under the wheel; extra packs elsewhere; any person, hand or animal; label boxes or arrows.

Use case: ChandRush Chapter 02 location reference plate L03_G, the loaded delivery trolley ready for dispatch beside the Food Street packing bench. Used in a counting scene: 16 cups and 16 packs must be exact.
Asset: one 4:3 landscape scenic image of an empty location, no characters.
Input images:
- Image 1: the approved plate L03_A, the empty trolley beside the packing bench. Use it for: the exact trolley design (blue-and-brass frame, brass ball finials, handle, four wheels, upper carrier of 16 round cup sockets in 4 rows of 4, separate lower shelf with removable tray, the "MAXIMUM LOAD 4.5 kg" plate and "0.5 kg" tray tag), the cream bench, Return Walk doorway, paving, light. Ignore: the parked cart and the round table (out of this view).
- Image 2: the Food Street master. Use it for: material and lighting reference only. Ignore: all white label boxes, annotation words and arrows.
Camera and framing: from the central aisle, three-quarter view towards the near-left packing bench and Return Walk doorway. The trolley fills the centre foreground; camera moderately above the upper carrier, so all cup rows are visible, while still looking obliquely into the lower shelf. Handle, carrier, lower loading opening and all four wheel contacts visible. Clear floor behind the handle; a level route leads beside the bench to the Return Walk door at left. The round table is outside the right frame edge.
State at this moment (exact):
1. Upper carrier: exactly 16 (sixteen) upright brass quarter-litre cups, each with a closed flat brass cap, in 4 (four) rows of 4 (four), one per socket, total 16. Do not show 15 or 17 cups, or an uncapped cup.
2. Lower shelf: the removable tray sits fully on the shelf and holds exactly 16 (sixteen) sealed packs laid flat in a single layer of 4 (four) rows of 4 (four), small gaps between packs. Packs are cream with a simple orange-and-green fruit-and-cracker picture, no writing. The upper carrier hides part of the back rows; the tray rim, the front row of packs and shelf support stay visible through the opening.
3. The trolley's note clip on the handle and the wall clip above the bench are empty.
4. Trolley stationary, every wheel on the paving.
Physical inscriptions (render exactly, nothing else): brass plate on the front edge of the lower shelf reading "MAXIMUM LOAD 4.5 kg", bold dark letters, about one eighth of the frame width; brass tag on the removable tray rim reading "0.5 kg", bold, about one fifteenth of the frame width. Decimals use a full stop. No other numbers, letters or words anywhere; cups, caps and packs blank.
Keep clear and visible: the 4×4 cups; lower opening with tray rim and front packs; both inscriptions; wheel contacts.
Light: warm amber lamps and cool moonlight, as in Image 1.
Do not show: packs stacked in two layers; packs on the upper carrier; "4,5" or "0,5"; any person, hand or animal; label boxes or arrows.
